entries.description: Russia's largest firearms manufacturer Izhmash unveiled a prototype of its new Kalashnikov AK-12 assault rifle in February 2012 with improved ergonomics and tactical flexibility, designed as a basic platform for nearly 20 different modifications. The AK-12 was presented to the public in June 2012 at the Engineer Technologies exhibition in Moscow and started entering service with Russian army units in 2020.
specs: Operation: gas-operated, long-stroke gas piston, rotary bolt locking, selective fire (single shot, 3-round burst, automatic)

entries.description: Public technical profile of AK-12 Kalashnikov.
specs: Variants: The basic feature of the new rifle is its modularity. It will serve as a basic platform for designing of over 20 modifications of small-arms weapons of various purposes and caliber.

Design: Kalashnikov AK-12 assault rifle is a gas-operated, selective fire weapon using traditional type action with long-stroke gas piston and rotary bolt locking as a standard Kalashnikov assault rifle. Firing selector levers are located above the pistol grip, at both sides of the rifle. The AK-12 features three firing modes: single shot, three-shot burst and automatic fire. The muzzle of the AK-12 has b

Ammunition: The AK-12 will be chambered in the traditional 7.62x39mm and 5.45x39mm calibers and available in NATO’s 5.56x45mm as well. It has been reported that all AK-47/AKM magazines will work with the AK-12.

Accessories: The AK-12 assault rifle is also fitted with Picatinny rails at the top of the weapon and additional accessory rails at both sides to mount optical, and night sights, grenade launchers, target indicators and other special equipment. The AK-12 has a folding stock and a height-adjustable heelpiece.

The FGS provides unparalleled image resolution in situations where active infrared (IR) illumination is not an option.

It attaches to standard dovetail interface helmet mounts and is powered by a remote battery back mounted on the rear of the helmet. entries.description: Public technical profile of AN/PVS-7D F5001.

To increase the protection on soldiers outside of combat vehicle, Raytheon BBN Technologies developed Boomerang Warrior-X, a soldier wearable shooter detection system. Boomerang Warrior-X is the best performing, most cost-effective compact dismounted shooter detection system available worldwide.

Sight: The sights are calibrated up to 1,500 meters. It is claimed that at this range, shot dispersion is stated to be a maximum of 300 mm in width and 342 to 820 mm in height. The machine gun mounts a standard attachment point for various optical and optronic sights.

Accessories: The Pecheneg machine gun is fitted with non-removable folding bipod which is placed near the muzzle. This feature is said to improve stability and long-range accuracy when firing from the bipod. It also retains the standard PKM mounting interface and therefore can be used from the same tripod. The PIVOT is a surveillance system developed and manufactured by the French Defence Company ACOEM through its METRAVIB brand. It's a a surveillance system designed for rapid deployment. It comprises a high-speed turret fitted with a day-vision camera. A second mount is available for a night-vision camera or binoculars.
specs: Product description: PIVOT (PIlar Versatile Observation Turret) is a rapidly deployable and man-portable surveillance system, consisting of a high speed pan-and-tilt turret equipped with a Day Camera and optionally with multi-function thermal imagers.The PIVOT can be fitted with night vision camera, multifunction binoculars or thermal weapon sight.

System Components: The PIVOT system is made up of two principal components: •A double-mount turret (maximum load 9 kg) that is compact (dimensions: H 45 x W 26 x D 27.5 cm) and lightweight (9 kg) enabling the camera to be pivoted towards the point of origin of the threat •A lightweight (4.8 kg) and compact (dimensions H 13 x W 15 x L 42 cm) day-vision colour camera with automatic or manual focus.

Features: The technical features of the PIVOT system make it ideal for use in the field: •Functional, with two video channels, a day-vision camera and optional night-vision sensor •Easy to use, with automatic sweeping •High-speed pan and tilt turret •Hard drive recording function •Practical, as it is totally compatible with the PILARw enemy fire detection system. •Delivered in shock-proof cases.

About Acoem (Metravib): Through its METRAVIB brand, ACOEM offers high-performance threat surveillance, detection and localization solutions for the defense and civil protection sectors. The systems developed by METRAVIB use the sound waves generated by the firing of small arms, grenades (RPGs), mortars and explosive devices (IEDs) to detect and accurately identify their location in real time.

The M1C and M1D were sniper versions of the M1 Garand. The two models differed only in the telescope mounts. The M1C mounted a model M81 2.5X telescope; the M1D an M82 2.5X telescope. Sécurité: Le cran de sureté se trouve du côté gauche de l'arme juste derrière la poignée pistolet qui ser d'emplacment du chargeur. En position haute l'arme est en sureté, en position basse l'arme est prête au tir. La cadence de tir est choisie en fonction de la pression sur le détente. Canon: Le canon dépasse légèrement de l'avant de l'arme.

Crosse: La crosse est rétractable, elle constituée par une barre de métal lisse qui se termine par un petit épauloir. En position rentré, elle se glisse le long de la carcasse de l'arme et sur toute la longueur.
